description: Read-only XRPL NFT marketplace-offer lookup for one NFTokenID. `offer_type=buy` retrieves native `nft_buy_offers`, `sell` retrieves `nft_sell_offers`, and `both` retrieves both sides; `buy_marker` and `sell_marker` paginate the two sides independently. Use `ledger_hash` or `ledger_index` to pin the lookup to a ledger, and `limit` to bound returned offers. Use this for marketplace offers on a specific NFT; use n9t2_xrpl_list_account_nfts for owned-NFT inventory and n9t2_xrpl_list_account_objects with `object_type='nft_offer'` when raw NFTokenOffer ledger entries are required.

buy_marker.description: Pagination marker for the NFT buy-offer side.
buy_marker.title: Buy Marker

ledger_hash.description: Optional ledger hash used to pin the NFT-offer lookup.
ledger_hash.title: Ledger Hash

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of NFT offers to return.
limit.title: Limit

nft_id.description: Canonical NFTokenID identifying the NFT whose marketplace offers should be retrieved.
nft_id.title: Nft Id

offer_type.description: NFT marketplace offer side to retrieve: buy, sell, or both. Default is both.
offer_type.title: Offer Type

sell_marker.description: Pagination marker for the NFT sell-offer side.
sell_marker.title: Sell Marker

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_nft_offers
